# UserInfo

## Structure opening

In the studied implementation, the message identifier is followed by coordinates, vehicle identifier, object identifier and character name.

Character attributes follow. The complete types and field order remain partially documented.

## Applicability

This revision belongs to the Gracia Epilogue profile. Orfen sharing revision 152 does not make this layout applicable there.
